games.name: Sandbox
games.rules: A free-form table with no rules. One deck starts in the stock — deal it out and arrange the cards however you like. You make the rules — it's all about having fun.

games.name: Sandbox (2 decks)
games.rules: A free-form table with no rules, dealt from two decks across two stocks. Arrange the cards however you like — you make the rules and play just for fun.

games.name: Sandbox (Jokers)
games.rules: A free-form table with no rules. One deck starts in the stock — deal it out and arrange the cards however you like. You make the rules — it's all about having fun.

games.name: Sandbox (2 decks, Jokers)
games.rules: A free-form table with no rules, dealt from two decks across two stocks. Arrange the cards however you like — you make the rules and play just for fun.

games.name: Klondike
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Tableau columns build **down in alternating colour** (e.g. a red 6 on a black 7). Move a single card or a valid run.
- Only **face-up** cards can be picked up; uncovering a face-down card flips it.
- An empty column can be started with a **King** (or a run headed by a King).
- Draw from the **stock** to the waste; recycle the waste back to the stock when it runs out.

games.name: Klondike (Draw 3)
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Tableau columns build **down in alternating colour** (e.g. a red 6 on a black 7). Move a single card or a valid run.
- Only **face-up** cards can be picked up; uncovering a face-down card flips it.
- An empty column can be started with a **King** (or a run headed by a King).
- Draw from the **stock** to the waste **three cards at a time**; only the top card of the waste is in play. Recycle the waste back to the stock when it runs out.

games.name: FreeCell
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Tableau columns build **down in alternating colour** (e.g. a red 6 on a black 7).
- You move strictly **one card at a time**. A run already in alternating-colour order can be dragged as a group, but only as many cards as you could move by hand: **(1 + free cells) × 2 for each empty column**. Free a cell or clear a column to move a longer run.
- Each of the four **free cells** holds a single card — use them as temporary parking.

games.name: Spider (1 Suit)
games.rules:
**Goal:** assemble eight complete King-to-Ace runs and move them to the foundations.

- Tableau columns build **down in any suit**. Spider has 1, 2, or 4-suit variations; this table enforces the **1-suit variation** (suits are interchangeable, so any descending run can be moved together).
- Only **face-up** cards can be picked up; uncovering a face-down card flips it.
- Any card may start an empty column.
- When you're stuck, **tap the stock** to deal one card onto every column — allowed only when **no column is empty**.
- A **complete King-to-Ace run** (all 13 cards) leaves for a foundation **on its own** the moment you finish it — there is nothing to drag.

games.name: Spider (4 Suits)
games.rules:
**Goal:** assemble eight complete **same-suit** King-to-Ace runs and move them to the foundations. This is the classic, hardest four-suit Spider.

- Tableau columns build **down in any suit** — a card lands on any card one rank higher, regardless of suit.
- Cards move as a group only when they form a **same-suit descending run**; otherwise you move **one card at a time**.
- Only **face-up** cards can be picked up; uncovering a face-down card flips it.
- Any card may start an empty column.
- When you're stuck, **tap the stock** to deal one card onto every column — allowed only when **no column is empty**.
- A **complete King-to-Ace run in a single suit** (all 13 cards) leaves for a foundation **on its own** the moment you finish it — there is nothing to drag.

games.name: Yukon
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Tableau columns build **down in alternating colour**.
- Any **face-up** card can be picked up together with everything on top of it, regardless of order — only the bottom card of the group needs to fit the target.
- Uncovering a face-down card flips it; an empty column takes a **King** (or a group headed by one).

games.name: Tri Peaks
games.rules:
**Goal:** clear all three pyramids onto the waste pile.

- Play any **fully uncovered** peak or base card onto the waste if it is one rank **up or down** from the waste's top card.
- Rank **wraps**: an Ace and a King are adjacent, so either can follow the other.
- Removing both cards covering a peak card flips it face-up and makes it playable.
- Draw the **stock** onto the waste when stuck (one pass only). No legal move with an empty stock means the game is **lost**.

games.name: Pyramid
games.rules: The classic 28-card **pyramid**. **Goal:** clear the whole pyramid. A card can be lifted only once the two cards overlapping it from below are gone — the base row is free to start, the rest open up as you clear toward the apex. Remove cards in pairs that total **13** (A=1 … Q=12) by dragging them onto the **discard**; a **King** (13) goes alone. The stock's top turns face-up and is playable; set turned cards aside on the waste. _Tip: the **Scarab** deck shows a small gold hint on each card — the rank it pairs with to reach 13._

games.name: Forty Thieves
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all eight foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Tableau columns build **down in the same suit**, **one card at a time** (no group moves).
- Any single card may start an empty column.
- Draw from the **stock** to the waste one card at a time; there is no recycling.

games.name: Golf
games.rules:
**Goal:** clear all seven tableau columns onto the foundation.

- Play the **top card** of any column onto the foundation if it is one rank **up or down** from the foundation's top card (no suit restriction).
- There is **no wrap**: only a Queen plays on a King, and only a 2 plays on an Ace.
- Stuck with no legal move and an empty stock? The game is **lost**.
- Draw the **stock** onto the foundation to keep going (one pass only — no recycling).

games.name: Clock
games.rules:
A game of pure luck. **Goal:** turn up all 52 cards before the fourth King appears.

- Flip the top card of the central pile, then tuck it face-up under the hour pile matching its rank (Ace = 1 o'clock … Queen = 12, Kings = centre).
- Continue from the top of the pile you just placed on.

games.name: La Belle Lucie
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- The board is **eighteen fans**. Build them **down in the same suit** (e.g. a ♥6 on a ♥7), **one card at a time** — only the exposed end card of a fan can move.
- An **emptied fan stays empty**: once a fan is cleared, nothing can be placed back into it.
- **Stuck? Tap the stock** to gather every fan, shuffle, and re-deal into threes. (Tradition allows two such redeals.)
- **Merci:** to free a card buried in a fan, turn on **FISH** (press **F**) and drag that card out — it will play wherever it legally lands. By tradition, once per game.

games.name: Canfield
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up in suit from the dealt base rank, wrapping past King back to Ace.

- The **first foundation card is dealt** — its rank sets the base for all four foundations. Build each one **up in the same suit**, wrapping King→Ace as needed.
- Tableau columns build **down in alternating colour** and also **wrap** (a King may go on an Ace). Move a single card or a valid run.
- The **reserve** of 13 cards feeds its top card into play; uncovering the next card turns it up.
- Draw **three at a time** from the stock to the waste; recycle the waste as often as you like.
- **Empty a column and the reserve refills it** at once. Once the reserve is spent, an empty column is yours to fill with any card or run.

games.name: Crazy Quilt
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all eight foundations to move every card home — four built **up in suit from Ace to King**, four built **down in suit from King to Ace** (two decks, so each suit fills one up-pile and one down-pile). The foundations **start seeded** with an Ace and a King of each suit.

- The **quilt** is 64 cards woven in a lattice. A quilt card is **available** when **either of its short ends** is clear — i.e. one of the two neighbours it points at is gone (cards on the rim start free).
- Play any available quilt card, or the **waste** top, onto a foundation.
- You may also lay an available quilt card on the **waste** if it is one rank **up or down** (any suit, and Ace/King wrap) — this chains, and is the main way to dig the weave open. Waste cards then only advance to foundations.
- Draw from the **stock** to the waste; recycle the waste when it runs out.

games.name: Beleaguered Castle
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up in suit from Ace to King.

- The four Aces begin in the centre, with eight six-card tableau wings around them. Every tableau card is face-up.
- Tableau piles build **down by rank regardless of suit**.
- Move only one exposed card at a time. Any single card may fill an empty tableau pile.
- There is no stock, waste, reserve, or free cell: success comes from creating and preserving empty spaces.

games.name: Bisley
games.rules:
**Goal:** move every card to eight foundations. Each suit is built from both ends at once: **up from Ace** and **down from King**. The two foundations may meet at any rank.

- All 48 non-Aces start face-up in thirteen columns.
- Tableau cards build **one rank up or down in the same suit**.
- Move only one exposed card at a time. An empty column stays empty for the rest of the game.
- A released King starts its matching downward foundation; choose carefully which end of a suit receives each available card.

games.name: Calculation
games.rules:
**Goal:** move every card to the four foundations. Suit does not matter.

- The foundations start with **Ace, 2, 3, and 4**. They advance by **1, 2, 3, and 4 ranks** respectively, wrapping after King.
- The sequences all end at King: A-2-3...; 2-4-6...; 3-6-9...; and 4-8-Q....
- Play the face-up stock card straight to a foundation or park it on one of four holding piles.
- Holding piles accept stock cards in any order, but only their top card can leave, and cards cannot move between holding piles. Plan carefully: there is no redeal.

games.name: Eight Off
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Tableau columns build **down in the same suit** (a 6 of spades on a 7 of spades).
- Eight **free cells** hold one card each — four of them start with a card from the deal.
- Only a **King** may start an empty column.
- A descending same-suit run can be dragged as a group, but only as far as free cells and empty columns could relay it by hand: **(1 + free cells) × 2 for each empty column**.

games.name: Seahaven Towers
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Ten columns of five cards build **down in the same suit** (a 6 of spades on a 7 of spades).
- Four **free cells** hold one card each — two of them start with a card from the deal.
- Only a **King** may start an empty column, so freeing your Kings is the opening problem.
- A descending same-suit run can be dragged as a group, but only as far as free cells and empty columns could relay it by hand: **(1 + free cells) × 2 for each empty column**.

games.name: Black Hole
games.rules:
**Goal:** play all fifty-one fan cards into the black hole.

- The **Ace of Spades** starts in the hole. Play the **exposed end card** of any fan onto it if that card is one rank **up or down** from the hole's top card.
- **Suit does not matter**, and rank **wraps**: an Ace and a King are adjacent, so either can follow the other.
- Cards never leave the hole, and a fan is never a drop target — every move is one-way.
- There is no stock and no redeal. When no fan's end card fits, the game is **lost**.

games.name: Scorpion
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Tableau columns build **down in the same suit**.
- Any **face-up** card can be picked up together with everything on top of it, **regardless of order** — only the bottom card of the group has to fit the target. That is how you dig out a buried card.
- Uncovering a face-down card flips it. An empty column takes a **King**, or a group headed by one.
- Three cards are held back: **tap the stock** once when you are stuck to deal them onto the first three columns.

games.name: Flower Garden
games.rules:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- The **bouquet** across the top is a spread of sixteen cards, and **any** of them may be played — reach into the middle, not just the end.
- The six **flower beds** build **down in any suit**, **one card at a time**.
- An emptied bed may be filled by any single card.
- Nothing is hidden and there is no stock: every card is face-up from the start, so the whole game is a puzzle you can see.
